== Summary ==

Crop rectangle <code>(133, 442, 1398, 2231)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>9dbc600769892af2ae57b69a119586e3da3308a692e0c0bc3282756d2e3cd380</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
